escalations.resolution: Invoker authorized one targeted guided retry and reset the rework counter.

escalations.situation: After the two invoker-authorized guided attempts, independent lead review found that the new public validation::rule_loader owns ambient filesystem reads and exposes a mixed caller-bytes/live-schema API, contrary to approved plan section 2 and D14.
escalations.resolution: Invoker chose lead take-over. Lead moved load_ruleset to storage::ruleset_store, deleted validation::rule_loader and the mixed helper, routed callers, fixed prose, added boundary tests (commit 6f4f11ac). cargo-ci passed; code-review then surfaced two more foundational deviations, triggering the batch audit below.
escalations.recommendation: Authorize one narrow correction that moves the non-mutation loader to storage, deletes the mixed-snapshot helper, routes captured paths through pure parsing only, fixes stale prose, and adds boundary coverage.

escalations.situation: Fifth review round: the whole-diff code-review kept surfacing new plan deviations in the ~6300-line foundation each round (non-convergence).
escalations.resolution: Invoker chose a batch plan-conformance audit. Lead fanned out 8 disjoint-footprint auditors over declarations + repository_state vs plan section 2, with an adversarial verify stage. 5 deviations confirmed (empty-string root sentinel -> RootRelativePath Root/Descendant enum; CaptureSpec phase-one Data-only; ExpectedPreimage kind vocabulary mirroring RepositoryEntry; managed-document claimed-child removal rejection; ConfigurationDeclarations transitional whole-config field removed), all fixed with tests (commit ff542ec1). Both gates then passed and the whole-diff code-review found nothing new, breaking the non-convergence. cbc3a7e5 done; merged to main at 0d224f35 (invoker-directed).

escalations.situation: Rework attempt 2 closed all 10 prior findings (independently verified, no regressions) but the independent crash-consistency review found 4 new lead-verified defects: HIGH shared worktree .jit-bootstrap namespace unserialized across disjoint-data-root sessions (orphan companion sweep can delete a live transaction's rollback backup); MEDIUM committed-journal recovery re-asserts worktree final identities and wedges opens after legitimate post-commit edits; LOW memory-backend failure-point parity gap; LOW tautological held-FD capability revalidation.
escalations.resolution: Invoker authorized one guided correction round scoped to exactly these 4 findings and reset the rework counter.
escalations.recommendation: Guided correction: worktree-keyed serialization / data-root-bound companion markers; idempotent committed-recovery cleanup; model kernel-only failure points in memory backend; reopen-by-path revalidation.

escalations.situation: code-review run b1991dfd-f094-43b5-961b-b310bac4d4f6 failed with one high finding: production mutation paths (IssueStore per-file publishers, init/profile direct FileTransactionKernel use) are not migrated to open_mutation_session, reading the issue's 'no per-file or command-semantic method survives' as requiring adoption in this package. Sibling of round 2's delta-normalization alias gap; rework counter at MAX (2).

escalations.resolution: Invoker chose a batch conformance audit (wave-1 remedy): disjoint-footprint auditors over the wave-2 surface vs the issue contract with adversarial verification, then one fix pass for all confirmed findings before re-gating.
escalations.recommendation: Lead recommended fix + property-based parity test; invoker selected the broader audit.

escalations.situation: After two rework attempts closed the original seed-omission finding, plan encapsulation, and HashMap serialization nondeterminism, final adversarial review found one ordinary API pairing defect: RepositoryMutationSession::apply accepts image and plan separately, so a plan derived from image A can be applied alongside image B when action-target preimages match, recording A's semantic hash after revalidating B.
escalations.resolution: Invoker authorized option 1: one minimal guided correction that makes MaterializationPlan own its captured RepositoryImage and makes apply accept only the plan, followed by the issue gates.
escalations.recommendation: Authorize one guided minimal correction: MaterializationPlan owns the captured RepositoryImage and apply accepts only the plan, structurally binding image, delta, and hash without storage-side rehashing or a validation framework.

escalations.situation: Increment 8 must delete the ambient resolve_plan_content fallback (no-dual-path constraint), but two production sites (main.rs:1883-1891, crates/server/src/main.rs:75-76) build executors with a best-effort layout and fall back when absent. Recorded as binding ruling 16 in handoff-10.

escalations.situation: After two rework attempts, independent review found two related lifecycle-repair defects: the final captured index is not validated for schema, duplicate/deleted membership, or path-id versus embedded Issue.id consistency; and RepairIssueLifecycle clones the caller record, allowing non-lifecycle fields to bypass normal update reconciliation. A mismatched indexed record can therefore overwrite another issue.
escalations.resolution: Invoker authorized one narrow guided correction and reset the rework counter, followed by the issue gates once the remaining issue scope is complete.
escalations.recommendation: Authorize one narrow guided correction: parse and validate the final captured index with ordinary repository invariants, reject duplicate/deleted/mismatched records with zero writes, constrain RepairIssueLifecycle to copy only first_ready_at/claimed_at/done_at onto the captured preimage, correct the two stale retry/atomicity comments, and add focused zero-write regressions before independent review.

escalations.situation: After the two invoker-authorized lifecycle/index rework attempts, lifecycle repair and shared index validation pass, but final review found aggregated membership applies lower-priority HEAD/main tombstones globally and can hide a higher-priority locally restored issue. Main-worktree discovery also swallows nonzero git failures and retains structural unwraps.
escalations.resolution: Invoker authorized a narrow lead-owned correction with conflict/error regressions and one independent verification.
escalations.recommendation: Authorize one lead-owned narrow correction: preserve local then HEAD then main membership precedence per ID, type absence separately from Git/I/O/structural failure without unwraps, add conflict and malformed-main regressions, then perform one independent verification before resuming the broader consumer cutover.

escalations.situation: Independent review found two blocking document-capture defects (pinned adds borrowed worktree bytes and capture budgets were self-sized) and three startup-recovery ownership/reporting defects (foreign-session adoption, a Send session over thread-local guard state, and skipped controls counted as recovered) after the issue rework count reached two.
escalations.resolution: Invoker selected option 1 and authorized one narrowly guided escalation. The counter was reset once; the correction is limited to these reviewed defects and requires independent re-review before further consumer cutover.
escalations.recommendation: Correct only the reviewed document and startup-recovery defects with fixed bounds, explicit ownership, exact reports, focused regressions, and net deletion where practical.

escalations.situation: After the transition cutover rework counter reached two, final independent review found five correctness gaps: Ready precheck classification can change without detection; precheck evidence omits consumed gate status, run history, and prompt-file bytes; lease evidence uses ambient cwd without the coordinator/claims lock; dependency removal does not re-resolve raw IDs on recapture; and postchecks re-resolve a short ID after commit. The diff passes its focused 20-test matrix, formatting, and Clippy, but duplicates full-repository preflight/recapture and grows by 752 net lines while retaining those evidence holes.
escalations.resolution: Invoker selected option 1 and authorized one narrow guided correction with a counter reset, limited to the five reviewed evidence/identity defects, deletion of adjacent duplicate blocking logic where practical, focused adversarial regressions, and independent verification.
escalations.recommendation: Authorize one narrow guided correction and counter reset: recompute precheck classification on recapture; replace blanket output exclusions with purpose-specific checker evidence that captures manual statuses, relevant run history, checker outputs, and prompt-file bytes; acquire the explicit-layout coordinator and claims lock across capture and publication; re-resolve original dependency IDs; return the canonical lifecycle ID for postchecks; delete duplicated blocking logic where practical; add focused adversarial regressions; then require independent verification.

escalations.situation: After the issue rework counter reached two, independent review of the captured gate-preset cutover found a backend-parity blocker: CreateGatePreset publishes custom preset bytes into InMemoryStorage's aggregate repository image, but InMemoryStorage::list_gate_presets and get_gate_preset still read builtins only, so an immediately created preset is invisible to list/show on that backend. The JSON reader and captured apply path use the centralized custom-file policy correctly.
escalations.resolution: Invoker selected option 1 and authorized one narrow guided correction with a counter reset, limited to in-memory custom-preset read parity, one create-to-list/show regression, bounded checks, and independent re-review.
escalations.recommendation: Authorize one narrow guided correction and counter reset: make the in-memory read methods project custom preset JSON files from the aggregate repository image through the shared load_presets_from_custom_files policy, add one create-to-list/show backend-parity regression, rerun the preset/template/cargo checks, and require independent re-review. Do not add another preset cache or compatibility fallback.

escalations.situation: After rework attempt two, final independent review of the standalone gate-evaluation cutover found six remaining contract/parity defects: full-length IDs are normalized instead of requiring exact canonical spelling; every gate-runs root child is treated as a directory and per-run listings exhaust the 256-listing budget after roughly 255 runs; memory readers do not validate gate-run parent kinds like JSON; lifecycle capture/evidence still reconstructs and broadly matches gate-run result paths outside the canonical helper; JSON's leaf-only O_NOFOLLOW does not protect swappable parent components; and ReviewPlaceholder captures document evidence it never consumes.
escalations.resolution: Invoker selected option 1 and authorized one narrow guided correction with a counter reset, limited to the six reviewed defects, shared gate-run closure consolidation, focused regressions, and independent final re-review.
escalations.recommendation: Authorize one narrow guided correction with a counter reset: preserve exact full-ID resolution; replace per-run listings with one shared three-phase root-listing/direct-child-kind/exact-result closure used by standalone and lifecycle capture; mirror JSON parent-kind checks in memory; route every lifecycle result path and matcher through the canonical helper; open gate-run paths through retained no-follow directory capabilities; restrict document evidence to Exec; add bounded clutter, >256-run, parent-parity, full-ID, lifecycle, parent-swap, and placeholder-isolation regressions; then require independent final re-review.

escalations.situation: After archive rework attempt two, independent review of the net-negative discovery/pinned-evidence extraction found that closure acquisition reparses every accumulated prefix on each evidence wave, discards the completed parsed map, and parses the full closure again during derivation, producing roughly quadratic parsing on deep dependency chains. The new incremental closure and target-relevant pinned-request contracts also lack direct pure tests. Focused behavior tests, formatting, strict Clippy, and diff checks pass.
escalations.resolution: Invoker selected option 1 and authorized one narrow guided correction with a counter reset, limited to persistent parsed closure state, direct pure boundary tests, contract documentation, and independent re-review; marker/location extraction and archive transaction work remain excluded.
escalations.recommendation: Authorize one narrow guided correction with a counter reset: carry the parsed accumulator through Needs waves into the completed derivation, add small pure tests for Needs-to-Complete reuse, terminal evidence, shared/cyclic reachability, and target-relevant deduplicated pin requests, fix stale resolver wording/public contract docs, rerun focused checks, and require independent re-review. Do not expand into marker/location extraction or archive transaction code in this correction.

escalations.situation: After graph-export rework attempt two closed the external symlink-alias bypass, independent review found that the shared no-follow absolute-directory walker converts every normal path component to UTF-8. On Unix this regresses all repository sessions beneath a valid non-UTF-8 ancestor; a reproduced jit init now fails before publication with an unsafe-target error. Focused graph/export/store tests, formatting, strict Clippy, and diff checks otherwise pass.
escalations.resolution: Invoker selected option 1 and authorized one narrow guided correction with a counter reset, limited to preserving OsStr components in the existing capability walk, one Unix regression, focused checks, and independent re-review.
escalations.recommendation: Authorize one narrow guided correction with a counter reset: preserve OsStr path components through the existing capability walk, add one Unix non-UTF-8-ancestor repository-session regression, rerun graph/store/init focused checks, and require independent re-review. Do not change export classification, capability publication, snapshot behavior, or other repository-state semantics.
